profile.summary: Accuracy Shipping Limited provides third party logistics solutions in India and internationally. The company offers custom clearance, sea cargo, and air cargo; vessel and train chartering; road, rail, and project cargo transportation; and normal, bonded, and cold storage warehousing services. It also sells petroleum and petroleum products; and motor vehicles. It serves marbles and granite, ceramic
